ways.label: North-South Track, Karangahake Gorge to Kaimai Summit
evidence: The track starts from Karangahake Gorge, off SH2 at Karangahake. The track exits on to SH29 at the Kaimai Summit.
The recommended North-South track is via Waitawheta Hut, and the Waitawheta and Wharawhara valleys.

not_on_route.name: old North-South track via Mount Te Aroha, Pahiko and Wahine Rock

doubts: The start is matched to the Karangahake Gorge name (T11); the only road end feature near there is on Dickey Flat Road, which the text does not mention. Motutapere Hut's place in the order is inferred from 'the track between Motutapere Hut and Te Whare Okioki'; the itinerary does not list it. Hurunui Hut is taken as on the way because Day 6 ends at 'Hurunui Hut or Kaimai Summit (SH29)' with an optional Day 7 from Hurunui Hut to Kaimai Summit. The page says the walk can be shortened at side tracks but names none. The old North-South route along the main range is an alternative described only briefly, without start or end, so it is not recorded as a way; its ref T4 (Old North South Route) is assumed from the name.
